issues.description: std.json.ObjectMap.init(alloc) does not exist in Zig 0.16 — ObjectMap is an unmanaged type initialized with .{} and uses allocator-passing put(alloc, key, val). Fixed by replacing init call with .{} literal and updating put calls.
issues.resolution: Changed 'std.json.ObjectMap.init(alloc)' to 'std.json.ObjectMap = .{}' and 'put(key, val)' to 'put(alloc, key, val)'.

issues.description: mergeVariables result was captured as 'const' but deinit(*Self) requires a mutable receiver. Fixed by changing 'const result = ...' to 'var result = ...'.
issues.resolution: Changed const to var for the mergeVariables result binding.
